column1: # Additional authored revisions, with specific contexts instead of repeated templates.
# term|English example|Chinese translation
apprenticeship|Young people who complete an apprenticeship can gain a recognised qualification while earning a wage and acquiring practical experience.|完成学徒培训的年轻人可以在挣取工资、积累实践经验的同时取得被认可的资格。
pedagogy|Evidence-informed pedagogy encourages teachers to consider research findings alongside their knowledge of the pupils in front of them.|以证据为参考的教学法鼓励教师把研究发现与自己对班上学生的了解结合起来。
seminar|During the seminar, students compared two explanations for unequal educational outcomes and questioned the evidence supporting each one.|研讨课上，学生比较了对教育结果不平等的两种解释，并质疑各自所依据的证据。
supervision|Regular academic supervision helped the student narrow her research question before she began collecting data from local schools.|定期的学术指导帮助这名学生在开始从当地学校收集数据前缩小了研究问题的范围。
dissertation|Her dissertation examines whether adults with irregular working hours face additional barriers to participating in further education.|她的学位论文研究工时不规律的成年人在参加继续教育时是否面临额外障碍。
attainment|Differences in educational attainment cannot be explained by school quality alone, since housing and family resources also matter.|教育程度的差异不能仅用学校质量解释，因为住房和家庭资源同样有影响。
memorisation|Rote memorisation may help students recall terminology, but it does not necessarily enable them to apply a concept in an unfamiliar situation.|机械背诵或许有助于学生回忆术语，但不一定使他们能够在陌生情境中应用概念。
cognitive|Asking beginners to interpret a complex graph while learning new terminology can place excessive cognitive demands on them.|让初学者在学习新术语的同时解读复杂图表，可能对他们提出过高的认知要求。
inclusive|Inclusive education requires more than admitting pupils with different needs; teaching materials and assessment methods must also be accessible.|全纳教育不仅需要接收有不同需求的学生，还必须让教学材料和考核方法便于他们使用。
remedial|The college provides remedial teaching in mathematics so that gaps in prior learning do not prevent students from completing technical courses.|学院提供数学补救教学，以免先前学习中的缺漏阻碍学生完成技术课程。

curricular|Curricular choices reflect competing demands, such as preparing pupils for employment while allowing time for creative and physical activities.|课程选择反映了不同需求之间的权衡，例如既让学生为就业做好准备，又为创造性和体育活动留出时间。
bandwidth|Students with limited bandwidth could download an audio version of the lecture instead of attempting to stream the entire video.|带宽有限的学生可以下载讲座的音频版本，而不必尝试在线播放整段视频。
latency|High latency made it difficult for musicians in different cities to rehearse together, even though the sound quality was otherwise acceptable.|高延迟使不同城市的音乐家难以一起排练，尽管声音质量在其他方面尚可。
vulnerability|The security vulnerability was reported before the software was widely adopted, allowing the developer to release a corrective update.|这个安全漏洞在软件被广泛采用之前就被报告，使开发者能够发布修复更新。
anonymise|Researchers anonymised interview records before sharing them, removing details that could identify participants in a small rural community.|研究人员在共享访谈记录前将其匿名化，去除了可能识别一个小型农村社区中参与者身份的细节。
configure|The library provides illustrated instructions so that visitors can configure their devices to use the wireless network without staff assistance.|图书馆提供图解说明，让访客无须工作人员帮助就能配置设备以使用无线网络。
synchronise|The application stores records locally and synchronises them when a reliable connection becomes available, reducing interruptions during fieldwork.|该应用将记录保存在本地，在有可靠连接时再同步，减少了实地工作中的中断。
malfunction|An equipment malfunction interrupted the demonstration, so the technician used a recorded example to explain the remaining stages.|设备故障中断了演示，因此技术员用一段录制好的示例解释余下步骤。
redundant|Removing redundant information from the application form reduced completion time without depriving assessors of details needed to make a decision.|删除申请表中的多余信息缩短了填写时间，同时没有让审核人员缺少作出决定所需的细节。
deploy|The organisation will deploy the new booking system in stages so that staff can identify problems before all departments begin using it.|该机构将分阶段部署新的预订系统，以便工作人员在所有部门启用之前发现问题。
deforestation|Demand for agricultural land can contribute to deforestation even where the commercial value of the timber itself is relatively low.|即使木材本身的商业价值较低，对农业用地的需求也可能加剧森林砍伐。
reforestation|A successful reforestation programme must consider the survival of young trees, rather than reporting only how many were planted.|成功的重新造林计划必须考虑幼树的存活情况，而不能只报告种植数量。
watershed|Watershed management links activities upstream with conditions downstream, recognising that changes on farmland may affect water supplies in towns.|流域管理把上游活动与下游状况联系起来，认识到农田上的变化可能影响城镇供水。
runoff|Replacing gardens with paved surfaces can increase runoff during heavy rain because less water is able to soak into the soil.|把花园改成铺装地面会使更少的水渗入土壤，从而可能增加暴雨时的径流。
infiltration|Compacted soil can reduce water infiltration, increasing the amount of rainfall that flows directly into nearby drains and streams.|被压实的土壤可能减少水分下渗，使更多雨水直接流入附近的排水设施和溪流。
canopy|Expanding tree canopy along walking routes may offer immediate shade once trees mature, although maintenance and water needs must be considered.|扩大步行路线上的树冠覆盖，在树木成熟后可直接提供遮阴，但也必须考虑养护和用水需求。
vegetation|Native vegetation was restored along the riverbank to reduce erosion and provide a more continuous habitat for local wildlife.|河岸沿线恢复了本地植被，以减少侵蚀，并为当地野生动物提供更连续的栖息地。
pollinator|A garden with plants that flower at different times can support pollinators for longer than one planted with a single flowering species.|种有不同花期开花植物的花园，比只种一种开花植物的花园能更长时间地支持传粉动物。
invasive|The invasive species spread rapidly through disturbed ground, displacing native plants that had previously provided food for local insects.|这一入侵物种在受扰动的土地上迅速扩散，挤占了原本为当地昆虫提供食物的本地植物。

endangered|Protecting an endangered species may require restoring the conditions it depends on, rather than simply increasing the number of individuals in captivity.|保护濒危物种可能需要恢复它赖以生存的环境条件，而不只是增加圈养个体的数量。
discharge|The study measured industrial discharge at several points along the river to distinguish factory pollution from other sources of contamination.|研究在河流沿线的几个位置测量工业排放，以区分工厂污染与其他污染来源。
particulate matter|Monitoring stations recorded higher levels of fine particulate matter near the main road, particularly during the morning traffic peak.|监测站记录到主干道附近的细颗粒物水平较高，尤其是在早高峰时段。

environmental degradation|Short-term increases in agricultural output may conceal environmental degradation if declining soil quality is not included in the assessment.|如果评估未纳入土壤质量下降，农业产出的短期增加可能掩盖环境退化。
stewardship|Environmental stewardship requires institutions to consider who will maintain restored habitats after the initial project funding has ended.|负责任的环境管理要求机构考虑，在项目的初始资金结束后由谁维护恢复的栖息地。

immunity|Population immunity can change as protection declines or new groups become exposed, so earlier estimates may not describe current risk accurately.|随着保护作用减弱或新群体暴露，群体免疫水平可能变化，因此早期估计未必能准确描述当前风险。
rehabilitation|Physical rehabilitation after an injury may involve a gradual increase in activity, with exercises adapted to each patient's progress.|受伤后的身体康复可能需要逐渐增加活动量，并根据每位患者的恢复进度调整练习。

adherence|Clear instructions and affordable prescriptions can improve treatment adherence by addressing practical obstacles rather than assuming patients lack motivation.|清晰的说明和可负担的处方费用可以通过解决实际障碍来改善治疗依从性，而不只是认定患者缺乏动力。

fatigue|Persistent fatigue affected some employees' concentration, prompting the organisation to review shift patterns rather than simply demand greater effort.|持续疲劳影响了部分员工的注意力，促使机构检查轮班安排，而不只是要求员工更加努力。
alertness|Students recorded their daytime alertness over two weeks so that the researchers could compare reported sleep quality with concentration in class.|学生连续两周记录白天的清醒程度，让研究人员能够比较他们报告的睡眠质量与课堂注意力。
circadian|Exposure to light late at night can influence circadian rhythms, although the response depends on the timing and intensity of the light.|深夜接触光线可能影响昼夜节律，但具体反应取决于光照的时间和强度。
deprivation|Sleep deprivation can impair sustained attention, which is particularly concerning for workers who operate vehicles or other hazardous equipment.|睡眠不足会削弱持续注意力，对驾驶车辆或操作其他危险设备的工作人员尤其值得关注。
respiratory|Improving respiratory health may require action on housing conditions and air pollution as well as access to clinical treatment.|改善呼吸系统健康可能既需要获得临床治疗，也需要改善住房条件和空气污染。
cardiovascular|The study examined cardiovascular health over several years, taking account of differences in participants' age and smoking history.|这项研究历时数年考察心血管健康，并考虑了参与者年龄和吸烟史的差异。
epidemic|An effective epidemic response depends on timely information, but public trust also affects whether people follow advice and report symptoms.|有效应对流行病需要及时的信息，但公众信任也影响人们是否遵循建议并报告症状。
occupational health|Occupational health services helped employees return after a long absence by recommending changes to their tasks and working hours.|职业健康服务通过建议调整任务与工时，帮助长期缺勤的员工重返工作。
health inequality|Housing costs can contribute to health inequalities when poorer households are forced to live in damp homes far from essential services.|当较贫困家庭被迫居住在潮湿且远离基本服务的住房中时，住房成本可能加剧健康不平等。
outpatient|Expanding outpatient care can reduce the need for hospital stays, provided that patients have appropriate support and transport at home.|如果患者在居家期间获得适当支持和交通保障，扩大门诊医疗可以减少住院需求。
referral|The doctor arranged a specialist referral because the symptoms had persisted despite the initial treatment, rather than repeating the same prescription.|由于初步治疗后症状仍然持续，医生安排了专科转诊，而没有重复开出相同处方。

capacity building|Local capacity building included training maintenance staff and securing a reliable supply of spare parts, rather than simply installing equipment.|地方能力建设包括培训维护人员、确保可靠的备件供应，而不只是安装设备。
municipal|Municipal services must respond to changing local needs, especially when new housing increases demand for waste collection and public transport.|市政服务必须回应不断变化的当地需求，尤其是在新建住房增加垃圾收集和公共交通需求时。
borough|The borough council is consulting residents about a proposal to convert an unused car park into housing and public open space.|区议会正在就把一个闲置停车场改建为住房和公共开放空间的提案征询居民意见。
eviction|Unstable income can increase the risk of eviction because households may be unable to recover from even a short period without paid work.|收入不稳定会增加被驱逐出出租住房的风险，因为家庭可能无法承受即便短期没有有偿工作带来的冲击。

occupancy|Staff measured room occupancy throughout the week before deciding whether the university needed additional teaching space or a different timetable.|工作人员测量了一周内各时段的教室使用情况，再决定大学是需要增加教学空间还是调整课表。

sanitation|Providing basic sanitation is essential in rapidly growing settlements, where household construction may outpace the expansion of public infrastructure.|在快速扩大的聚居地，住宅建设可能快于公共基础设施扩建，因此提供基本环境卫生设施至关重要。
drainage|Urban drainage designed around past rainfall patterns may need upgrading as heavier storms place greater pressure on existing pipes.|随着更强的暴雨给现有管道带来更大压力，按过去降雨模式设计的城市排水系统可能需要升级。
sewage|Reliable sewage treatment requires trained staff and regular maintenance, so construction costs alone do not indicate the full cost of the service.|可靠的污水处理需要受过培训的员工和定期维护，因此仅靠建设成本不能反映服务的全部成本。
junction|The new crossing was placed near a busy junction after residents reported difficulty reaching the bus stop on the other side.|居民反映难以到达马路对面的公交站后，新过街设施被设在一个繁忙交叉口附近。

retrofitting|Building retrofitting can improve energy performance while retaining existing structures, although older properties may require individual assessments.|既有建筑改造可以在保留原结构的同时提高能源性能，但较旧的房产可能需要逐一评估。
insulation|Improved thermal insulation can reduce heating demand, but ventilation must also be considered to avoid trapping moisture indoors.|改善隔热保温可以降低供暖需求，但也必须考虑通风，以免水汽滞留室内。
ventilation|Natural ventilation depends on building layout and outdoor conditions, so a design that works in one climate may be unsuitable in another.|自然通风取决于建筑布局和室外条件，因此适合某种气候的设计未必适合另一种气候。
land use|Land-use planning influences how far residents travel to work and shops, making it an important part of transport policy.|土地利用规划影响居民前往工作地点和商店的距离，因此是交通政策的重要组成部分。

step-free access|The new library entrance provides step-free access, allowing wheelchair users and parents with pushchairs to enter without using a separate service route.|图书馆的新入口提供无台阶通道，让轮椅使用者和推婴儿车的家长无须使用单独的服务通道即可进入。

planning permission|The owners must apply for planning permission before redevelopment because the proposed changes would affect the appearance of a protected building.|业主必须在重新开发前申请规划许可，因为拟议的改动会影响一座受保护建筑的外观。

procurement|Public procurement rules can encourage repairable products by requiring suppliers to explain how equipment will be maintained throughout its working life.|公共采购规则可以要求供应商说明设备整个使用寿命内如何维护，从而鼓励采购可维修产品。
commodity|Commodity prices can fluctuate sharply when supply is disrupted, even if consumer demand changes very little during the same period.|供应中断时，大宗商品价格可能剧烈波动，即使同期消费者需求几乎没有变化。
enterprise|A small enterprise may struggle to finance new equipment even when the investment would reduce its running costs over time.|小型企业可能难以筹资购买新设备，即使这项投资会逐渐降低运营成本。

competition|Market competition does not always remove barriers to entry, particularly where newcomers must build expensive infrastructure before gaining customers.|市场竞争不一定能消除进入壁垒，尤其是在新进入者必须先建设昂贵基础设施才能获得客户时。
liability|The contract clarifies liability for damage to borrowed equipment, including who pays if a fault results from improper installation.|合同明确了借用设备受损时的责任，包括安装不当引起故障时由谁付款。
recession|An economic recession can reduce public revenue at the same time as unemployment increases demand for financial support.|经济衰退会减少公共财政收入，同时失业增加对经济援助的需求。
fiscal|Fiscal policy can support employment through public spending, although governments must consider how additional expenditure will be financed.|财政政策可以通过公共支出支持就业，但政府必须考虑如何为新增支出筹资。
monetary|Monetary policy influences borrowing costs, which can affect household spending and businesses' willingness to invest in new equipment.|货币政策影响借贷成本，进而可能影响家庭支出和企业投资新设备的意愿。
provision|Service provision should reflect the needs of the population rather than assume that the same opening hours suit every community.|服务供给应反映人口需求，而不能假定相同的开放时间适合每个社区。
purchasing power|When wages rise more slowly than prices, household purchasing power falls even though the amount of money earned has increased.|当工资上涨慢于物价时，即使挣到的金额增加，家庭购买力仍会下降。
economies of scale|Shared purchasing arrangements may help small schools achieve economies of scale without requiring them to give up control over teaching.|共同采购安排可能帮助小型学校实现规模经济，而无须让它们放弃教学自主权。

budget constraint|The team worked within a strict budget constraint by repairing existing equipment and postponing upgrades that offered little immediate benefit.|团队通过维修现有设备、推迟短期收益有限的升级，在严格的预算约束内开展工作。
empirical|The claim that smaller classes improve attainment requires empirical evidence rather than relying only on teachers' personal impressions.|小班教学能提高学业成就这一主张需要实证证据，而不能只依赖教师的个人印象。
qualitative|Qualitative research helped explain why some residents avoided the park, revealing concerns that had not been included in the original questionnaire.|定性研究帮助解释了为何部分居民不去公园，揭示了原始问卷未纳入的顾虑。
quantitative|The researchers combined quantitative data on journey times with interviews about why commuters preferred one route over another.|研究人员把出行时间的定量数据，与通勤者为何更喜欢某条路线的访谈结合起来。
longitudinal|A longitudinal study followed the same households for a decade to examine how changes in income affected their housing choices.|一项纵向研究追踪同一批家庭十年，以考察收入变化如何影响他们的住房选择。
baseline|The baseline measurement was taken before the training began, providing a reference against which later changes could be assessed.|基线测量在培训开始前进行，为评估此后的变化提供了参照。
threshold|Setting a warning threshold involves balancing the harm caused by missed events against the disruption caused by false alarms.|设置预警阈值需要权衡漏报事件造成的损害与误报造成的干扰。
calibration|Probability calibration examines whether events assigned a similar likelihood occur at roughly the expected frequency over many forecasts.|概率校准考察在多次预测中，被赋予相近概率的事件是否大致按预期频率发生。
robust|The finding appeared robust because the main pattern remained when the researchers excluded unusual observations and used alternative measures.|这一发现显得稳健，因为研究人员排除异常观测值、采用替代测量后，主要模式仍然存在。
tentative|Given the small sample and short observation period, the researchers presented their conclusion as tentative rather than definitive.|鉴于样本较小、观察期较短，研究人员将结论表述为暂定而非确定结论。

operational definition|Observers agreed on an operational definition of participation before collecting data, reducing disagreement about which classroom behaviours should be counted.|观察人员在收集数据前就“参与”的操作性定义达成一致，减少了对哪些课堂行为应被计数的分歧。
mentoring|Structured mentoring gave new colleagues a regular opportunity to discuss difficulties that they might otherwise hesitate to raise with their manager.|有组织的导师指导让新同事定期有机会讨论原本可能不敢向经理提出的困难。
appraisal|A performance appraisal should use clear expectations and relevant evidence, rather than judge an employee solely by the most recent incident.|绩效考评应使用明确的标准和相关证据，而不能只根据最近的一件事判断员工。
contractual|Both parties should understand their contractual obligations before work begins, especially who is responsible if materials arrive late.|双方应在工作开始前了解合同义务，尤其是材料迟到时由谁负责。
grievance|A clear grievance procedure gives employees a way to raise concerns without relying entirely on their relationship with an immediate supervisor.|清晰的申诉程序让员工有途径提出关切，而无须完全依赖与直属主管的关系。
overtime|Frequent unpaid overtime can undermine work-life balance and may indicate that staffing levels do not match the organisation's workload.|频繁无偿加班会损害工作与生活的平衡，也可能表明人员配置与组织的工作量不匹配。
reskilling|A reskilling programme helped workers move into equipment maintenance when demand for their previous manufacturing roles declined.|当原有制造岗位的需求下降时，一项再培训计划帮助员工转向设备维护岗位。
upskilling|Employers who invest in new machinery may also need to invest in upskilling so that existing staff can use it safely and effectively.|投资新机械的雇主可能还需要投入技能提升培训，让现有员工能够安全、有效地使用设备。

staff turnover|High staff turnover made it difficult to retain organisational knowledge, since experienced employees often left before training their replacements.|较高的员工流动率使组织难以保留知识，因为资深员工往往在培训接任者之前便已离职。
performance indicator|A performance indicator based only on the number of appointments may overlook whether patients actually receive appropriate and timely care.|只依据就诊次数的绩效指标，可能忽视患者是否真正获得适当、及时的医疗服务。
social capital|Repeated cooperation between neighbours can build social capital, making it easier to organise shared activities when a new problem arises.|邻里之间反复合作可以建立社会资本，使新的问题出现时更容易组织集体活动。
underrepresented|The team contacted local organisations to reach groups that were underrepresented in responses to the online consultation.|团队联系了当地组织，以接触在线咨询回复中代表不足的群体。
sediment|Storms can move coastal sediment and expose archaeological remains that had been protected beneath sand for several centuries.|风暴可以搬运海岸沉积物，暴露出数百年来一直受沙层保护的考古遗存。
excavation|Archaeological excavation requires careful recording because removing material changes the very context that researchers are trying to understand.|考古发掘需要谨慎记录，因为移除材料会改变研究人员试图理解的背景本身。
artefact|Researchers record an artefact alongside its surrounding context, since its location may reveal more than its appearance alone.|研究人员会连同周围背景记录一件文物，因为其位置所揭示的信息可能比外观本身更多。
fossil|Gaps in the fossil record limit the certainty with which researchers can reconstruct changes in species over long periods.|化石记录中的缺漏，限制了研究人员重建物种长期变化过程时的确定程度。
geological|Geological evidence from successive layers of rock can reveal changes in climate that occurred long before written records began.|连续岩层中的地质证据可以揭示远早于文字记录开始时期发生的气候变化。
terrestrial|Terrestrial ecosystems respond differently to drought depending on the vegetation, soil conditions and the length of time without rainfall.|陆地生态系统对干旱的反应因植被、土壤条件和无降雨持续时间而异。
marine|Marine habitats can be affected by activities far inland when fertilisers and other pollutants are carried to the coast by rivers.|当肥料和其他污染物经河流被带到海岸时，远离海岸的内陆活动也可能影响海洋栖息地。
nocturnal|Artificial lighting can alter the behaviour of nocturnal species by changing when they emerge and where they search for food.|人工照明可能改变夜行性物种出现的时间和觅食地点，从而改变其行为。
glare|Shielding street lights can reduce glare for pedestrians while directing useful illumination onto the pavement rather than into nearby homes.|为路灯加装遮光装置，可以减少对行人的眩光，并把有效照明投向人行道而非附近住宅。
seedling|The experiment compared seedling survival in shaded and exposed plots to examine whether young plants benefited from existing vegetation.|实验比较了遮阴与暴露地块中幼苗的存活情况，以考察幼苗是否受益于现有植被。
germination|Storage conditions affected seed germination, so the researchers kept a separate record of temperature and humidity for each collection.|储存条件影响了种子萌发，因此研究人员为每批收藏分别记录温度和湿度。

viability|Curators periodically check seed viability to identify collections that need to be regenerated before too many seeds lose the ability to germinate.|保管人员定期检查种子存活能力，以便在过多种子失去萌发能力前，识别需要重新繁殖补充的收藏。
dormancy|Seed dormancy can delay germination until conditions are suitable, helping plants avoid emerging during a brief warm period followed by frost.|种子休眠可以把萌发推迟到条件适宜时，帮助植物避免在随后会出现霜冻的短暂暖期出苗。
dispersal|Animals contribute to seed dispersal when they carry fruit away from the parent plant and leave viable seeds in new locations.|动物把果实带离母株、将仍有活力的种子留在新地点时，就促进了种子传播。
foraging|Researchers observed foraging behaviour at different times to determine whether artificial light changed when birds began searching for food.|研究人员在不同时段观察觅食行为，以确定人工光照是否改变了鸟类开始觅食的时间。
camouflage|Effective camouflage depends on the surrounding environment, so a colour pattern that hides an animal in woodland may expose it on bare ground.|有效的伪装取决于周围环境，因此在林地中能隐藏动物的色彩图案，在裸地上可能反而使它暴露。
predation|Predation pressure differed between the experimental plots, making it difficult to attribute changes in insect numbers to temperature alone.|实验地块之间的捕食压力不同，因此难以把昆虫数量变化仅归因于温度。
plausible|A plausible explanation still needs to be tested against evidence, especially when several different processes could produce the same pattern.|看似合理的解释仍需要用证据检验，尤其是在几种不同过程都可能产生同一模式时。
substantiate|The report describes improvements in satisfaction but provides no survey details that would allow readers to substantiate the claim.|报告描述了满意度的提高，却没有提供能让读者核实该主张的调查细节。
overlook|A single average can overlook important differences between neighbourhoods, particularly when access to services is highly uneven.|单一平均值可能忽视街区之间的重要差异，尤其是在服务获得机会高度不均时。
undermine|Unexplained inconsistencies between the chart and the accompanying text can undermine confidence in an otherwise carefully conducted study.|图表与配套文字之间未得到解释的不一致，会削弱人们对一项其他方面实施严谨的研究的信心。

distinguish between|A clear report distinguishes between what the researchers directly observed and the interpretation they propose to explain those observations.|清晰的报告会区分研究人员直接观察到的内容与他们为解释这些观察而提出的解读。
